name: ERPNext
hook: Full-featured open-source ERP — accounting, inventory, HR, manufacturing — free forever.
bullets: Covers accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, HR, and manufacturing in one app
No per-user pricing — free and open source under GPL-3.0
38k+ GitHub stars, 30,000+ companies using it worldwide
setupSteps: Install bench CLI: pip install frappe-bench
Initialize bench and create a site
details: ERPNext is a 100% open-source enterprise resource planning system built on Frappe Framework. It replaces expensive proprietary ERPs like SAP and Oracle NetSuite with a free, community-driven alternative. Modules include accounting with double-entry bookkeeping, inventory with batch/serial tracking, purchasing, sales, CRM, HR with payroll, manufacturing with BOM and job cards, project management, and a point-of-sale system. Over 30,000 companies worldwide use ERPNext, from small businesses to enterprises. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
setup: Self-hosted (needs Python, MariaDB, Redis) or Frappe Cloud
